about_the_game:
Special Thanks

Thanks to aamatniekss for providing "Free Pixelart Platformer Tileset"、“Fantasy Knight - Free Pixelart Animated Character”.

Thanks to BDragon1727 for providing "Basic Pixel Health bar and Scroll bar"、“Retro Impact Effect Pack 5”.

Thanks to Leo Red for providing "ucid-icon-pack".

Thanks to greatdocbrown for providing "coins-chests-etc-2-0.png".

Thanks to LuizMelo for providing "Monsters Creatures Fantasy".

Thanks to Mounir Tohami for providing "Pixel Art GUI Elements".

Thanks to Clement Panchout for providing "yet-another-free-music-pack",
no modifications have been made.

Thanks to Ellr for providing "Universal UI/Menu Soundpack",no modifications have been made.

Thanks to PaperHatLizard for providing "Cryo's Mini GUI".

Thanks to Leohpaz for providing "Minifantasy_Dungeon_Music".

The player takes on the role of a knight in a mysterious world and finds himself surrounded by monsters and robots. These monsters may come from another dimension or from creatures manipulated by the dark forces, while robots are created by technologically advanced civilizations. The hero must uncover the secrets of the world, find the source of power, and fight these monsters and robots.

The hero can choose to take a gun or a sword as a weapon, each weapon has its own characteristics and fighting style. A gun can provide long-range attack capabilities, suitable for long-range enemies or robots, while a sword provides a closer combat and combat experience, suitable for close combat and monsters.

The hero encounters a variety of monsters and robot enemies during the journey, each of which has unique abilities and weaknesses. The protagonist needs to learn and adapt to different combat strategies, using the environment and his own skills to defeat the enemy.
